title: Lid Cover Broken/Missing (Storm Sewer Manhole) - Hazardous
categories: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
description: Use this request type to report a broken or missing inlet cover, inlet grate, or storm sewer manhole cover that is broken, and may pose a potential hazard to pedestrian or vehicular traffic. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.

observedQuestions.question: What type of lid is it?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

pathCoverage: All three lid types and all six location choices tried; Other revealed required description.
Continue advanced to Contact. No contact data entered.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a broken or missing inlet cover, inlet grate, or storm sewer manhole cover that may pose a hazard to pedestrian or vehicular traffic.
actions.why: For a broken or missing inlet cover, inlet grate, or storm sewer manhole cover that may pose a hazard to pedestrian or vehicular traffic. The request form asks lid type and location, including alley, median, roadside, sidewalk, or in street.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways" > Choose "Lid Cover Broken/Missing (Storm Sewer Manhole) - Hazardous"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways" > Choose "Lid Cover Broken/Missing (Storm Sewer Manhole) - Hazardous"
